niche_preference_profile: Prefers polished, contemporary interfaces with strong hierarchy, clear grouping, and a composed visual rhythm. They consistently like immersive or editorial presentation, especially when paired with large titles, soft but intentional card structure, and layouts that feel complete rather than empty. They value visible functionality and actionable content, but not chaotic clutter: they prefer interfaces that are populated, organized, and purposeful. They also respond well to expressive identity cues such as real photos or colorful icons when those elements add warmth, personality, or realism. In alerts, they favor calm, serious, non-alarmist treatment with subdued emphasis and strong modal focus.

criteria.description: Prefers large, bold, high-presence titles and clearer headline-to-section hierarchy with a more editorial feel.
Prefers content that is crisply organized into distinct sections, labeled groups, or modular blocks with obvious structure.
Prefers layouts with more whitespace, calmer pacing, and deliberate spacing between major elements rather than cramped stacking.
Prefers full-width or immersive photographic hero treatment that creates warmth, atmosphere, and a lifestyle/editorial mood.
Prefers colorful, characterful visual elements such as vivid icon tiles, avatars, or photos that add friendliness, realism, and personality.
Prefers screens that show concrete content, clear actions, and obvious management affordances rather than sparse or passive states.
Prefers rounded, polished, gently integrated cards or grouped surfaces over harsh, thin, or unfinished-looking containers.
Prefers warning and modal designs that feel serious, composed, and non-alarmist, using restrained color and sober tone instead of aggressive urgency.
Prefers compositions with one clear focal area, subdued background distraction, and an overall sense of completeness and polish.
